inputs.label: Star Fox asset file (Starfox-Assets.BIN)
inputs.help: Made on a Windows PC from your own unmodified Star Fox or Starwing cartridge dump (.sfc or .smc). Do not share your ROM or BIN.

preparedWith.help: Download StarFoxAssetBuilder-<version>-windows-x64.zip from the same release, run it with your ROM, and it creates Starfox-Assets.BIN.

steps.why: Android creates Android/data/com.starfox.enhanced.quest/files on the first launch.

steps.text: Open Star Fox Enhanced from Library > Unknown Sources.

notes: The guide imports the BIN through a first-launch picker and pushes it only as a fallback; qgp pushes it directly, which skips the picker. The APK path inside the zip (StarFoxEnhanced-quest-arm64.apk) comes from the guide for 0.0.8.8.1 and was not checked against the current zip. The release also has an android-arm64 APK and a steam-frame zip, which are not the Quest build. Supported ROMs: Star Fox JP 1.0/1.1, USA 1.0/1.1/1.2, Starwing EU 1.0/1.1, DE 1.0. Alpha VR build.
